unit.id: Island Evolution#1

segment.target: Ebolusyon sa isla

unit.id: Evolution usually takes place over thousands of years. In this simulation, many generations pass within a few minutes, so you can observe how a population changes over time.#1

segment.source: Evolution usually takes place over thousands of years. In this simulation, many generations pass within a few minutes, so you can observe how a population changes over time.
segment.target: Karaniwang inaabot ng libu-libong taon ang ebolusyon. Sa simulasyong ito, maraming henerasyon ang lumilipas sa loob ng ilang minuto, kaya mapagmamasdan mo ang pagbabago ng populasyon sa paglipas ng panahon.

unit.id: The scenario#1

segment.target: Sitwasyon

unit.id: A small population of creatures lives on an isolated island. Their only source of food is a few scattered berry bushes. Once a bush has been eaten, it takes some time for new berries to grow.#1

segment.source: A small population of creatures lives on an isolated island. Their only source of food is a few scattered berry bushes. Once a bush has been eaten, it takes some time for new berries to grow.
segment.target: May maliit na populasyon ng mga nilalang sa isang liblib na isla. Ang tanging pagkain nila ay mula sa ilang nagkalat na palumpong na may maliliit na prutas. Kapag nakain ang bunga, kailangan ng panahon bago tumubo ang panibago.

unit.id: Every move costs energy. A creature whose energy runs out dies.#1

segment.source: Every move costs energy. A creature whose energy runs out dies.
segment.target: Bawat galaw ay gumagamit ng enerhiya. Namamatay ang nilalang na nauubusan ng enerhiya.

unit.id: A creature with enough energy produces a child, which costs a large part of its energy.#1

segment.target: Kapag sapat ang enerhiya ng isang nilalang, nagkakaroon ito ng supling. Malaking bahagi ng enerhiya nito ang nagagamit dito.
